title: The Terrorist Attacks in Sri Lanka

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报 DealBook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的 DealBook 峰会上，现场采访商业、政治和文化领域的一些最具影响力的领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zoran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、佐兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以直接观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的真实对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将于 11 月 18 日在 nytimes.com 上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并免费获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望大家能准时收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: A series of highly coordinated bombings has left more than 300 dead in Sri Lanka.
sentences.zh: 斯里兰卡发生了一系列高度协同的爆炸事件，已造成 300 多人死亡。

sentences.en: How did a small, obscure, and under-financed local group carry out one of the deadliest terror attacks since 9-11?
sentences.zh: 一个规模小、名不见经传且资金不足的本土组织，是如何制造出 9·11 以来最致命的恐怖袭击之一的？

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, April 24th.
sentences.zh: 今天是 4 月 24 日，星期三。

sentences.en: Jeffrey Gettleman, take me back to a year ago in Sri Lanka.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里·格特尔曼，带我回顾一下一年前的斯里兰卡。

sentences.en: What was going on in the government there?
sentences.zh: 当时那里的政府发生了什么？

sentences.en: The Sri Lankan government was in complete meltdown.
sentences.zh: 斯里兰卡政府当时彻底陷入了瘫痪。

sentences.en: Sri Lanka is a developing country, somewhat isolated.
sentences.zh: 斯里兰卡是一个发展中国家，相对比较孤立。

sentences.en: It's an island off of
sentences.zh: 它是位于

sentences.en: India.
sentences.zh: 印度外海的一个岛国。

sentences.en: And for years, it struggled with a very brutal civil war that ended about 10 years ago.
sentences.zh: 多年来，它一直在与一场非常残酷的内战作斗争，这场内战大约在 10 年前结束。

sentences.en: So we are now witnessing the rebirth of this country after decades of bloodshed and dysfunction and confusion and chaos.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们现在看到的是这个国家在经历了几十年的流血、功能失调、混乱和动荡之后的重生。

sentences.en: And the government is a symptom of all these probleMs.
sentences.zh: 而政府正是所有这些问题的缩影。

sentences.en: A political crisis in Sri Lanka, where the president has sacked the country's entire parliament and called for fresh elections.
sentences.zh: 斯里兰卡发生政治危机，总统解散了该国整个议会并呼吁重新举行大选。

sentences.en: You had a division at the highest levels between the president and the prime minister.
sentences.zh: 总统和总理之间出现了最高层面的分歧。

sentences.en: They were disputing who was in control.
sentences.zh: 他们一直在争夺谁拥有控制权。

sentences.en: The president is accused of violating the constitution after he fired the prime minister and appointed a replacement.
sentences.zh: 总统在罢免总理并任命继任者后，被指控违反宪法。

sentences.en: And the president then appointed another person to become a new prime minister.
sentences.zh: 随后，总统又任命了另一个人担任新总理。

sentences.en: He replaced him with Mahinda Rajapaksa, an ex-president accused of war crimes.
sentences.zh: 他用马欣达·拉贾帕克萨取代了他，后者是一名被指控犯有战争罪的前总统。

sentences.en: The country's largest party has called the president a tyrant.
sentences.zh: 该国最大政党称总统为暴君。

sentences.en: The prime minister, they say, should be chosen by parliament, not the president.
sentences.zh: 他们表示，总理应该由议会选举产生，而不是由总统决定。

sentences.en: It provoked a constitutional crisis with lawmakers threatening to quit.
sentences.zh: 这引发了一场宪政危机，议员们威胁要辞职。

sentences.en: Police have been called into Sri Lanka's parliament after MPs flung books, chairs and water to stop a no-confidence motion.
sentences.zh: 在议员们投掷书籍、椅子和水以阻止不信任投票后，警察被召集进入斯里兰卡议会。

sentences.en: The tempers boiled over following discussions over who should lead the country.
sentences.zh: 在讨论谁应该领导国家之后，人们的情绪彻底失控了。

sentences.en: Supporters of Sri Lanka's ousted prime minister aren't going to let him go quietly.
sentences.zh: 斯里兰卡被罢免总理的支持者们不打算让他悄然离去。

sentences.en: And it all stemmed from this very bitter rivalry between the president and the prime minister, which still hasn't been resolved.
sentences.zh: 这一切都源于总统和总理之间至今尚未解决的极其激烈的竞争。

sentences.en: And throughout this turmoil that you're describing over the past year, what is happening simultaneously in Sri Lanka?
sentences.zh: 在你所描述的过去一年的动荡中，斯里兰卡同时发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, around the same time in December last year, when this political meltdown was still a big issue here and the government was dysfunctional, police officials in a small town
sentences.zh: 嗯，大约在去年 12 月的同一时期，当这里的政治危机仍然是一个大问题且政府陷入瘫痪时，位于

sentences.en: in central Sri Lanka learned about a mysterious preacher who had been indoctrinating young Muslim students and encouraging them to attack Buddhists and Buddhist statues.
sentences.zh: 斯里兰卡中部一个小镇的警方官员得知了一位神秘传教士的情况，他一直在向年轻的穆斯林学生灌输思想，并鼓励他们袭击佛教徒和佛教雕像。

sentences.en: They didn't know much about this guy.
sentences.zh: 他们对这个人知之甚少。

sentences.en: He was said to be a traveling preacher who had been run out of his own village because his views were too radical and hateful and he had been told to leave.
sentences.zh: 据说他是一名四处游历的传教士，因为他的观点过于激进和充满仇恨而被赶出了自己的村庄，并被勒令离开。

sentences.en: And ever since then, he had been traveling back and forth between India and Sri Lanka,
sentences.zh: 从那以后，他一直在印度和斯里兰卡之间来回奔波，

sentences.en: spreading these very hateful messages that Muslims are the only ones who deserve to be on earth, that Muslims have the right to kill anybody who's not Muslim,
sentences.zh: 散布这些充满仇恨的信息，称穆斯林是唯一配得上活在世上的人，穆斯林有权杀死任何非穆斯林的人，

sentences.en: and that anybody who's concerned about these issues should really take action and strike out against infidels.
sentences.zh: 任何关心这些问题的人都应该真正采取行动，打击异教徒。

sentences.en: Sri Lankan government doesn't really take it seriously.
sentences.zh: 斯里兰卡政府并没有真正重视这件事。

sentences.en: And at the same time, the Indian government, which has a pretty extensive intelligence network across South Asia and is constantly on the lookout for the rise of Islamic groups,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，在整个南亚拥有相当广泛的情报网络并时刻关注伊斯兰组织崛起的印度政府，

sentences.en: learns about this guy.
sentences.zh: 得知了这个人的存在。

sentences.en: And then in early April, India reaches out to Sri Lanka and says, they have specific information, Mohammed Zaharan and his followers are planning suicide attacks
sentences.zh: 接着在 4 月初，印度联系了斯里兰卡，称他们获得了具体情报，穆罕默德·扎哈兰及其追随者正计划在

sentences.en: across Sri Lanka at churches.
sentences.zh: 斯里兰卡各地的教堂发动自杀式袭击。

sentences.en: The Indians give the Sri Lankans very detailed information, the whereabouts of these people, their cell phone numbers, social media information, addresses, names, aliases.
sentences.zh: 印度人向斯里兰卡人提供了非常详细的情报，包括这些人的行踪、手机号码、社交媒体信息、地址、姓名和化名。

sentences.en: And the Sri Lankans then process the information and put together a security memo that they circulate among only a few assistant police chiefs.
sentences.zh: 随后，斯里兰卡人处理了这些情报，并编写了一份安全备忘录，仅在少数几位助理警察局长之间传阅。

sentences.en: And this memo was dated April 11th.
sentences.zh: 这份备忘录的日期是 4 月 11 日。

sentences.en: And it says, foreign intelligence agencies have given us information that Mohammed Zaharan
sentences.zh: 上面写着，外国情报机构向我们提供了情报，称穆罕默德·扎哈兰

sentences.en: is planning suicide attacks against Catholic churches in Sri Lanka, but no action is taken.
sentences.zh: 正计划对斯里兰卡的罗马天主教堂发动自杀式袭击，但并未采取任何行动。

sentences.en: How can that be possible that they're not taking any action?
sentences.zh: 他们怎么可能不采取任何行动呢？

sentences.en: Some people believe it goes back to this political division at the heart of the government,
sentences.zh: 一些人认为这可以追溯到政府核心的政治分歧，

sentences.en: that the president is so intent on shutting out the prime minister from any security matters
sentences.zh: 总统太急于将总理排挤出所有安全事务之外，

sentences.en: that he's hoarding all this information to himself and not really doing anything with it.
sentences.zh: 以至于他将所有情报都据为己有，却没有真正采取任何行动。

sentences.en: The suspects who are named in the memo are not arrested.
sentences.zh: 备忘录中点名的嫌疑人并未被捕。

sentences.en: No security is added at churches.
sentences.zh: 教堂也没有增加安保力量。

sentences.en: And life goes on until April 21St.
sentences.zh: 生活就这样继续着，直到 4 月 21 日。

sentences.en: At about 8.45 a.m., Easter Sunday, bombs explode at several churches and hotels across Sri Lanka.
sentences.zh: 大约上午 8 点 45 分，复活节星期日，斯里兰卡的多座教堂和酒店发生炸弹爆炸。

sentences.en: The story we're following, state media in Sri Lanka report three explosions were at hotels, three other explosions were at churches.
sentences.zh: 我们正在追踪的报道称，斯里兰卡官方媒体报道有三起爆炸发生在酒店，另外三起爆炸发生在教堂。

sentences.en: And keep this in mind.
sentences.zh: 请记住这一点。

sentences.en: I was actually in New Delhi, and I got a message that a few explosions had been heard, and several people were injured.
sentences.zh: 我当时在新德里，收到一条消息，称听到几起爆炸声，数人受伤。

sentences.en: Over the next couple of hours, we find out that dozens of people have been killed.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几个小时里，我们发现已有数十人丧生。

sentences.en: The information is still coming through, but the information that we have points to a devastating series of what looks like a series of coordinated attacks.
sentences.zh: 消息仍在不断传来，但我们掌握的信息指向了一系列破坏力极大、看似协同攻击的事件。

sentences.en: By the time I bought my plane tickets and was en route to Sri Lanka, the death toll was nearly 200 people.
sentences.zh: 等我买好机票在前往斯里兰卡的途中时，死亡人数已近 200 人。

sentences.en: It kept rising day by day and is now more than 320 people.
sentences.zh: 死亡人数日复一日地攀升，目前已超过 320 人。

sentences.en: This is the worst violence in Sri Lanka in more than 10 years since the end of the civil war there.
sentences.zh: 这是斯里兰卡内战结束 10 多年以来最严重的暴力事件。

sentences.en: And the people who were killed were worshippers, many children, several dozen foreign tourists.
sentences.zh: 遇难者包括礼拜者、许多儿童以及几十名外国游客。

sentences.en: Sri Lanka has a large tourism industry, and there were Americans, British, Australians, Indians, Chinese, Turkish, all killed in these attacks.
sentences.zh: 斯里兰卡的旅游业十分发达，袭击中丧生的人中有美国人、英国人、澳大利亚人、印度人、中国人、土耳其人。

sentences.en: And how do Sri Lankan officials respond to the attack early on?
sentences.zh: 斯里兰卡官员对早期的袭击有何反应？

sentences.en: So within hours, they arrest dozens of suspects.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们在几小时内逮捕了数十名嫌疑人。

sentences.en: They sweep through the city, Colombo, the capital, find a safe house with weapons in it, announce that they have arrested accomplices to the attackers.
sentences.zh: 他们搜查了首都科伦坡，找到了一处藏有武器的安全屋，并宣布他们已经逮捕了袭击者的同谋。

sentences.en: And that raised questions because it looked like they had known who was behind the attack from the beginning.
sentences.zh: 这引发了质疑，因为这看起来就像他们从一开始就知道是谁在袭击背后主使。

sentences.en: And shortly after that,
sentences.zh: 在那之后不久，

sentences.en: one minister in the government leaks this secret memo dated April 11th that says there was an imminent terrorist attack against Catholic churches in the works.
sentences.zh: 政府的一位部长泄露了这份日期为 4 月 11 日的秘密备忘录，其中称针对天主教堂的迫在眉睫的恐怖袭击正在酝酿之中。

sentences.en: And the anger begins to build that the government should have arrested these people and fortified the churches before Easter Sunday if they had suspected that there might be some attacks.
sentences.zh: 愤怒开始积聚，人们认为如果政府早怀疑可能会发生袭击，就应该在复活节星期日之前逮捕这些人并加固教堂。

sentences.en: And what are the big questions that reporters like you are trying to answer at this moment?
sentences.zh: 像你这样的记者此刻正试图回答的重大问题是什么？

sentences.en: So I was very confused how a local group that nobody's heard of could have accomplished such a devastating series of attacks.
sentences.zh: 我很困惑，一个默默无闻的本土组织怎么能完成如此具有毁灭性的一系列袭击。

sentences.en: I have covered suicide bombings in other places like Somalia and Iraq.
sentences.zh: 我曾在索马里和伊拉克等其他地方报道过自杀式炸弹袭击。

sentences.en: And I have seen the horror of people blown apart and buildings blown apart by very powerful explosives.
sentences.zh: 我亲眼见过威力巨大的炸药将人和建筑物炸得粉碎的恐怖场景。

sentences.en: And that's what this looked like.
sentences.zh: 这看起来就是那样。

sentences.en: There were six bombs that went off within minutes of each other, and each was incredibly powerful.
sentences.zh: 有六枚炸弹在几分钟内相继爆炸，每一枚的威力都极其惊人。

sentences.en: To build a bomb like that is complicated.
sentences.zh: 制造这样一枚炸弹是很复杂的。

sentences.en: To pack explosives into a small, carryable package and detonate it effectively in a closed space is the mark of a sophisticated terrorist organization.
sentences.zh: 将炸药装进一个小巧、便于携带的包裹中，并在封闭空间内有效地引爆它，这是一个成熟的恐怖组织的标志。

sentences.en: They had to have a foreign partner in this.
sentences.zh: 他们在这件事上必定有外国伙伴协助。

sentences.en: They had to have tapped into some international terror network and received expertise or manpower or weapons to be able to do this because there was no history in Sri Lanka of anything close to this scale.
sentences.zh: 他们一定接入了某个国际恐怖网络，并获得了专业技术、人力或武器支持才能做到这一点，因为斯里兰卡历史上从未有过接近这种规模的事情。

sentences.en: And the selection of the targets to go after churches on Easter seems such a spectacular crime against non-Muslims that it just made you wonder what group out there would have an agenda like that.
sentences.zh: 选择在复活节袭击教堂的目标，对非穆斯林来说是一起如此骇人听闻的罪行，这让人不禁想知道究竟是哪个组织会有这样的议程。

sentences.en: There really wasn't a local motivation to do that.
sentences.zh: 这样做其实并没有本土动机。

sentences.en: There had been no history of bloodshed between Muslims and Christians in Sri Lanka.
sentences.zh: 斯里兰卡历史上从未有过穆斯林与基督徒之间的流血冲突。

sentences.en: So it raised the question of what group outside this country would want to use this country to make a broader point.
sentences.zh: 这就引发了一个问题：这个国家之外的哪个组织会想利用这个国家来表达更广泛的诉求？

sentences.en: And that's when I started thinking about the Islamic State.
sentences.zh: 正是在那个时候，我开始想到伊斯兰国。

sentences.en: CNN has just learned that ISIS is now claiming responsibility for the coordinated Easter Sunday bombings.
sentences.zh: 美国有线电视新闻网（CNN）刚刚获悉，ISIS 现已宣称对复活节星期日的协同爆炸事件负责。

sentences.en: The Islamic State says it was behind the multiple suicide blasts, although it's not offered any proof.
sentences.zh: 伊斯兰国声称是多起自杀式爆炸的幕后黑手，不过它并未提供任何证据。

sentences.en: And when do we learn more about ISIS's involvement?
sentences.zh: 我们是什么时候对 ISIS 的卷入了解得更多的？

sentences.en: It was only until the third day of covering this story, around the clock, hour after hour, that we begin to hear of a Islamic State connection.
sentences.zh: 直到报道这起事件的第三天，没日没夜、一个小时接一个小时地追踪，我们才开始听到有关伊斯兰国的事端。

sentences.en: On Tuesday morning, we hear that the Islamic State has claimed this attack.
sentences.zh: 周二上午，我们听说伊斯兰国宣称对此次袭击负责。

sentences.en: That's not proof in itself, because, of course,
sentences.zh: 这本身并不能证明什么，因为当然，

sentences.en: the Islamic State is going to want to take credit for one of the most devastating terrorist attacks against Christians or non-Muslims in recent years.
sentences.zh: 伊斯兰国会想要将近年来针对基督徒或非穆斯林最具毁灭性的恐怖袭击之一的功劳揽在自己身上。

sentences.en: That was not proof in itself.
sentences.zh: 这本身并不是证据。

sentences.en: But by Tuesday night, the Islamic State released a video of Muhammad Zaharan posing with a weapon in front of a black Islamic State flag next to seven men whose faces are covered.
sentences.zh: 但到了周二晚间，伊斯兰国发布了一段视频，画面中穆罕默德·扎哈兰手持武器，站在黑色的伊斯兰国旗帜前，旁边是七名面部被遮挡的男子。

sentences.en: And in the video, he makes a pledge of allegiance to the Islamic State,
sentences.zh: 在视频中，他向伊斯兰国宣誓效忠，

sentences.en: and that basically clinches the connection between this little unknown group and one of the world's deadliest terror organizations.
sentences.zh: 这基本上确立了这个名不见经传的小组织与世界最致命恐怖组织之一之间的联系。

sentences.en: Jeffrey, did the Sri Lankan government know about this seeming involvement of ISIS ahead of time, when they were getting all those warnings?
sentences.zh: 杰弗里，斯里兰卡政府在收到所有这些警告时，是否提前知道了 ISIS 的这种涉案可能？

sentences.en: Was that in any of those notifications that they were getting beforehand?
sentences.zh: 他们先前收到的任何通知中提到过这一点吗？

sentences.en: There was nothing that we knew before today that showed the Sri Lankan government knew there was a Islamic State connection to this group.
sentences.zh: 在今天之前我们所了解的信息中，没有任何内容表明斯里兰卡政府知道该组织与伊斯兰国存在联系。

sentences.en: In that very detailed memo that lays out the names and addresses and phone numbers, there was no mention of the Islamic State.
sentences.zh: 在那份列出姓名、地址和电话号码的极其详细的备忘录中，没有提到伊斯兰国。

sentences.en: And the argument is that even if that was the case, the security agencies should have still looked more closely into it,
sentences.zh: 大家的争论点在于，即便事实如此，安全机构本仍应更深入地进行调查，

sentences.en: because they had detailed information from a credible partner, which is the Indian government.
sentences.zh: 因为他们获得了来自可靠合作伙伴（即印度政府）的详细情报。

sentences.en: So that's what's so frustrating, is that people in this country had very detailed information about what this group was planning.
sentences.zh: 所以最令人沮丧的是，这个国家的人掌握了关于该组织计划的非常详细的情报。

sentences.en: The mistake was nobody thought they were capable of doing it.
sentences.zh: 错误在于没有人认为他们有能力做到这一点。

sentences.en: So I wonder, what does it tell us that this small, local, not well-financed, not all that seriously taken group was able to be harnessed the way it was by ISIS?
sentences.zh: 我想知道，这个规模小、地方性、资金不足、不被当回事的组织能够被 ISIS 以这种方式利用，说明了什么？

sentences.en: I think it shows that there can be a partnership between any radical group, however much you discount them as inexperienced, under-resourced, not that threatening, eccentric.
sentences.zh: 我认为这表明，任何激进组织之间都可以建立伙伴关系，无论你多么认为他们缺乏经验、资源不足、威胁不大、行为古怪。

sentences.en: If they team up with the Islamic State or a global terror network, they can become incredibly dangerous.
sentences.zh: 如果他们与伊斯兰国或全球恐怖网络联手，就会变得极其危险。

sentences.en: And the fact that they're underestimated and dismissed and ignored is an advantage,
sentences.zh: 而他们被低估、被轻视、被忽视反倒成了一种优势，

sentences.en: because then they're able to set a plot like this in motion without a lot of scrutiny or harassment.
sentences.zh: 因为这样一来，他们就能在不受太多审查或干扰的情况下将这样的阴谋付诸实施。

sentences.en: But there's something else, though, is still really perplexing, which is, what does it mean to be connected to the Islamic State?
sentences.zh: 然而还有另一件事仍然令人十分困惑，那就是：与伊斯兰国建立联系究竟意味着什么？

sentences.en: So these guys here pledge allegiance to this, you know, greater jihadist philosophy.
sentences.zh: 这里的这些家伙宣誓效忠于这种，你知道的，更宏大的圣战思想。

sentences.en: But did they get training by the Islamic State?
sentences.zh: 但他们接受过伊斯兰国的训练吗？

sentences.en: Did they send people to Syria?
sentences.zh: 他们曾派人去过叙利亚吗？

sentences.en: Did the Islamic State send people here?
sentences.zh: 伊斯兰国曾派人来过这里吗？

sentences.en: Did they help them bring in the explosives?
sentences.zh: 他们协助运送炸药了吗？

sentences.en: How closely were the two sides working together?
sentences.zh: 双方合作的紧密程度如何？

sentences.en: We still don't know that.
sentences.zh: 我们对此仍然一无所知。

sentences.en: And who initiated contact?
sentences.zh: 是谁主动发起的接触？

sentences.en: Was it Mohammed Zaharan who reached out to them and said, I really need your help to accomplish this mission inside Sri Lanka?
sentences.zh: 是穆罕默德·扎哈兰主动联系他们并说“我真的很需要你们的帮助来完成我在斯里兰卡内部的这项任务”吗？

sentences.en: Or did the Islamic State spot an opportunity and maybe see some of his videos online and think, hmm, Sri Lanka is a pretty soft target.
sentences.zh: 还是伊斯兰国发现了机会，或许在网上看到了他的一些视频，然后心想：嗯，斯里兰卡是一个相当软弱的目标。

sentences.en: If we want to kill a lot of people, that's a great place to do it.
sentences.zh: 如果我们想杀死很多人，那是个好地方。

sentences.en: And maybe they cultivated him and used him to accomplish their agenda.
sentences.zh: 或许他们培养了他并利用他来达成他们的议程。

sentences.en: This is the type of stuff that we're trying to figure out.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们正试图弄清楚的事情。

sentences.en: And it's a huge investigation.
sentences.zh: 这是一项极其庞大的调查。

sentences.en: The American government has just sent FBI agents here to help.
sentences.zh: 美国政府刚刚派出了联邦调查局（FBI）特工来这里协助调查。

sentences.en: There's lots of foreign intelligence interest in this incident because of the high death toll and the way that these attacks unfolded.
sentences.zh: 鉴于死亡人数众多以及袭击事件的发展方式，各国的外国情报机构对这起事件表现出了极大的兴趣。

sentences.en: And it raises a question of how dangerous these homegrown groups can be.
sentences.zh: 这也引发了一个问题：这些本土组织能有多危险。

sentences.en: Because here was one that nobody was watching.
sentences.zh: 因为这里就有一个无人看管的组织。

sentences.en: And it pulled off one of the most devastating, horrific terrorist episodes of recent times.
sentences.zh: 它制造了近年来最具毁灭性、最可怕的恐怖事件之一。

sentences.en: And it feels at the end of the day like this is bigger than whatever decisions were being made by the Sri Lankan government.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，这感觉比斯里兰卡政府做出的任何决策都要宏大。

sentences.en: This is about an international terror group looking for local partners in ways that lots of small governments don't seem to understand.
sentences.zh: 这是关于一个国际恐怖组织在寻找当地合作伙伴，而许多小政府似乎并不理解这一点。

sentences.en: Yes, but local governments have to deal with these issues on the ground.
sentences.zh: 是的，但地方政府必须在实地处理这些问题。

sentences.en: There's no international Islamic State equivalent to fight terrorist groups.
sentences.zh: 并没有国际版“伊斯兰国”来负责打击恐怖组织。

sentences.en: You know, these issues are handled on the ground.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这些问题都是在实地处理的。

sentences.en: Some of the news that came out on Tuesday was that the cardinal of Sri Lanka's Catholic community was furious at the security forces and said,
sentences.zh: 周二发布的一些消息称，斯里兰卡天主教社群的主教对安全部队愤怒不已，并表示：

sentences.en: if you guys had told me there were threats against churches on Easter Sunday, I would have told people to stay home.
sentences.zh: 如果你们早告诉我复活节星期日有人威胁教堂，我就会让大家呆在家里。

sentences.en: But he wasn't given that information.
sentences.zh: 但他并没有得到这个消息。

sentences.en: And why is the FBI involved here, Jeffrey?
sentences.zh: 杰弗里，联邦调查局为什么会卷入其中？

sentences.en: There were a few Americans killed in the attacks.
sentences.zh: 袭击中有几名美国人丧生。

sentences.en: That is a concern to the American government.
sentences.zh: 这是美国政府关注的问题。

sentences.en: And therefore, they have some jurisdiction and reason to be here.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们拥有一定的司法管辖权和来这里的理由。

sentences.en: But it's much bigger than that.
sentences.zh: 但情况远不止于此。

sentences.en: What happened here in Sri Lanka is a very alarming sign for the rest of the world of how to co-opt a local group that has very little resources
sentences.zh: 斯里兰卡发生的事情给世界其他地方敲响了警钟，这是一个非常令人担忧的信号，展示了如何收买一个资源极少

sentences.en: and a pretty low profile to commit mass murder.
sentences.zh: 且极为低调的本土团伙来实施大规模谋杀。

sentences.en: How did this group evolve relatively quickly from the same one that was defacing statues and little more than that to a group that could blow up churches across the country
sentences.zh: 这个团伙是如何在相对较短的时间内，从那个只会涂抹雕像之类的组织，蜕变成一个能够在全国各地教堂发动连环爆炸

sentences.en: within minutes of each other and kill 300 or more people?
sentences.zh: 且相隔仅几分钟、炸死300多人的恐怖组织的？

sentences.en: I think they see this as an important case to work on because it has these bigger ramifications.
sentences.zh: 我认为他们认为这是一个重要的研究案例，因为它有着更广泛的深远影响。

sentences.en: It's the idea that the Islamic State, which has been defeated on the ground and lost a lot of territory, is still a very powerful virtual force.
sentences.zh: 这就是：伊斯兰国在实地被击败并失去了大量领土后，依然是一支非常强大的虚拟力量。

sentences.en: It can still indoctrinate people and encourage people and support people to do these horrific crimes.
sentences.zh: 它仍然可以对人们进行洗脑、鼓励并支持人们犯下这些滔天罪行。

sentences.en: Whether it has a town or a region in the Middle East that it controls or not, it's still a deadly force.
sentences.zh: 无论它在中东是否控制着一个城镇或地区，它依然是一支致命的力量。

sentences.en: That's what we all want to figure out, is how exactly did these two groups work together to carry this out?
sentences.zh: 这正是我们都想弄清楚的：这两个组织究竟是如何合作实施这一行动的？

sentences.en: And I think if we know that, it will help us understand how these groups pull off attacks like this.
sentences.zh: 我想如果我们知道了这一点，将有助于我们理解这些组织是如何策划此类袭击的。

sentences.en: And the idea is the better you understand that, the better chance you have of preventing the next one.
sentences.zh: 其核心理念是，你对这种情况理解得越深，阻止下一次袭击的胜算就越大。

sentences.en: Jeffrey, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里，非常感谢。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们对此表示感谢。

sentences.en: I'm glad to help.
sentences.zh: 我很乐意帮忙。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, mass funerals began for the victims of Sunday's attacks in Sri Lanka.
sentences.zh: 周二，斯里兰卡开始为周日袭击事件的遇难者举行集体葬礼。

sentences.en: Outside of one of the targeted churches, priests held back-to-back ceremonies in a large tent, several of them for small children.
sentences.zh: 在一个遭到袭击的教堂外，神职人员在一个大帐篷里接连举行仪式，其中几场是为小孩子举行的。

sentences.en: A few hours later, in a televised speech, Sri Lanka's president acknowledged his government's failure
sentences.zh: 几小时后，斯里兰卡总统在电视讲话中承认其政府未能

sentences.en: to detect the terror attacks beforehand and vowed to dismiss aides who had failed to act on the warnings.
sentences.zh: 事先侦测到恐怖袭击，并誓言解雇那些未能对警告采取行动的助手。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，享受30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: Today, we announced the first ever drug trafficking charges against a pharmaceutical company
sentences.zh: 今天，我们宣布了针对一家制药公司

sentences.en: and two of its executives for illegally distributing prescription drugs that help fuel the opioid epidemic.
sentences.zh: 及其两名高管的第一起毒品贩运指控，原因是他们非法分销助长阿片类药物流行的处方药。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, for the first time, federal authorities brought charges against a major pharmaceutical distributor
sentences.zh: 周二，联邦当局首次对一家大型药品分销商

sentences.en: and its executives that are usually reserved for street dealers and cartel leaders.
sentences.zh: 及其高管提出了通常只针对街头毒贩和贩毒集团头目指控。

sentences.en: The distributor, Rochester Drug Cooperative, was charged with felony drug trafficking
sentences.zh: 该分销商罗切斯特药物合作社因未能报告来自药房的可疑药品订单，在传播致命阿片类药物流行中扮演了角色，被控重罪贩毒。

sentences.en: for its role in spreading the deadly opioid epidemic by failing to report suspicious drug orders from pharmacies.
sentences.zh: 2012年至2017年期间，它向明知在非法分销麻醉药品的药房运送了数千万片极易上瘾的羟考酮药丸和芬太尼产品。

sentences.en: From 2012 to 2017, it shipped tens of millions of highly addictive oxycodone pills and fentanyl products to pharmacies that it knew were illegally dispensing narcotics.
sentences.zh: 由于这一结果，全国第六大药品分销商罗切斯特药物合作社

sentences.en: As a result, Rochester Drug Cooperative, the sixth largest drug distributor in the country,
sentences.zh: 将支付2000万美元罚款，并接受独立监督员为期五年的监督。

sentences.en: will pay a fine of $20 million and submit to five years of supervision by an independent monitor.
sentences.zh: 在起诉书指控的期间内，RDC从销售管制物质中获得了12亿美元的收入。

sentences.en: During the period alleged in the indictment, RDC generated $1.2 billion of revenues from the sale of controlled substances.
sentences.zh: 他们为什么要这么做？

sentences.en: Why did they do it?
sentences.zh: 答案是贪婪。

sentences.en: The answer is greed.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日播客》的全部内容。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
